visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product image gallery: one large product image at a time with round thumbnail navigation, auto-rotating
visualCharacteristics.layout: Large active image (slides horizontally); a centered row of round thumbnails below (wraps when there are many); no visible prev/next arrows (arrow keys work)

contentPattern.structure: One row per gallery image. cell 1: image (alt text kept); cell 2: optional caption text (usually empty). Any number of rows; rows without an image are ignored; a single image renders without controls

usage: Product photo gallery beside the product title and description on product detail pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only galleries with thumbnails. For side-by-side text and image slides use carousel-featured.
